title: Psalm 46 (Be Still And Know)
lyrics_original: Be still, and know that I am God:
Be still, and know that I am God:
I will be exalted among the heathen,
I will be exalted in the earth
Be still, and know that I am God.
Be still, and know that I am God:
Be still, and know that I am God:
I will be exalted among the heathen,
I will be exalted in the earth
Be still, and know that I am God.

bible_verses.english: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
Yahweh will fight for you, and you shall be still.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, quiet my anxious thoughts and teach my heart to be still before You today. When the pressures of life feel overwhelming, help me to remember that You are my refuge, my strength, and my defender. I release my need for control into Your capable hands, trusting that You will be glorified in every situation. Anchor my soul in Your unshakable peace. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, quiet my anxious thoughts and teach my heart to be still before You today. devotional.reflection_english: In a world full of noise, rushing thoughts, and constant demands, God gently invites us to quiet our hearts and take a deep breath in His presence. Resting in Him isn't about ignoring our troubles, but trusting that He is sovereign, faithful, and fully in control over every detail of our lives. When we surrender our anxiety and allow His peace to wash over us, we remember that He will be exalted above all things. Today, let go of the need to strive and simply rest in the truth of who He is.
